---
name: Epic template
about: Describe this issue template's purpose here.
title: EPIC- 
labels: 'epic'
assignees: ''

---

Title
    Short but descriptive title (e.g., “User Onboarding Revamp”)

Summary
    Brief overview of what this Epic aims to achieve.

Goals & Objectives
    Clearly outline the main objectives or measurable outcomes.

Business Value
    Why is this Epic important? What value does it bring to users or the organization?

Scope
    Define the general boundaries: what is included and what is explicitly out of scope.

Acceptance Criteria
    Bullet points explaining what must be true for this Epic to be considered complete.
    Example: “All key user workflows related to registration and login are documented.”
    Example: “UI/UX meets the new branding guidelines.”

Dependencies & Related Tickets
    List any dependencies, blocking items, or related stories/tasks (e.g., “Relates to #123, #124”).

Additional Notes
    Any further context, such as references, designs, or stakeholder input.
